overall_summary: This summary covers 20 of 30 entries received. Critical issues: a loose stairwell railing (Facilities); threatening messages from a groupmate (Social Environment); professor publicly humiliating a student’s accent (Social Environment); a student feeling unsafe as another waits outside a lecture hall (Social Environment); and a student experiencing overwhelming distress with no support (Well‑being). High‑severity problems include a last‑minute rubric change (Assessment), overwhelming deadline load (Well‑being), a lab‑booking system crash near deadlines (Administration), and no internship project work for three weeks (Internship Placement). Other frequent concerns are printing‑credit shortages and a vending‑machine coin loss (Facilities) and unclear marking criteria and unfair group grading (Assessment). Positive remarks note the new lab benches and a well‑organized capstone briefing.

theme_actions.suggested_action: Pass the loose stairwell railing report to estates/maintenance for immediate safety fix, and schedule regular inspections of stairways.
Review assessment rubrics to prevent last‑minute changes, ensure marking criteria are published before deadlines, and clarify group contribution grading to guarantee fairness.
Pass all three critical reports to campus safety and student welfare for immediate follow‑up, and establish a clear process for handling harassment, threats, and unsafe monitoring.
Adjust lecture slide pacing to allow note‑taking and continue the well‑organized capstone briefings that students praise.
Pass the distress report to student counselling for urgent support, and provide clearer guidance on managing workload deadlines to reduce high‑stress levels.
Fix the lab‑booking system crash before deadline periods, and evaluate implementing automatic timetable clash detection as suggested.
No actionable feedback; continue monitoring for more specific input.
Contact the IWSP company to secure project work promptly and inform the student of the expected timeline.
